# District10

> District10 is a full-service property marketing agency for Singapore real estate agents. We produce listing videos, virtual staging, social media content, and WhatsApp broadcast scripts — delivered in 4 hours, human-reviewed, and CEA-compliant.

## What We Do

District10 produces the complete marketing kit for a property listing:
- **Listing video** — cinematic walkthrough video for PropertyGuru, social, and WhatsApp
- **Virtual staging** — AI-staged room photos that show buyer potential without physical furniture
- **Instagram / social posts** — caption, hashtags, and creative ready to post
- **WhatsApp broadcast script** — personalised message ready to send to your contact list
- **Open house flyer** — print-ready PDF designed to your listing

## Who We Serve

Singapore licensed property agents (CEA-registered) selling HDB, condo, landed, and commercial listings.

## Key Facts

- Delivery time: 4 hours from briefing
- Cost: ~70% less than traditional marketing vendors
- CEA compliance: all output reviewed before delivery
- First listing kit: free
- Contact: +65 9712 1217 (WhatsApp)
